meta.title: Sutton SignWriting Office
meta.description: Meet the Sutton SignWriting Office, find the right contact, and follow active international work.
hero.title: A clear front door for Sutton SignWriting
hero.body: Find the right contact, meet the office roles, and see the active work connecting SignWriting communities around the world.
hero.readonly: This first release is informational and read-only. Email is the way to respond.
context.explainer: Choose a country or region to see useful spoken-language suggestions and known sign languages. Choose International for work between countries or on shared infrastructure. A flag identifies a place, never a language.
context.internationalSignData: Choose a country or region to see its known sign languages.
context.requestLanguage: Ask for a language or report a translation issue
context.notYetAvailable: This language is associated with the selected country but is not yet available for the interface.
contact.title: Choose the route that fits
contact.intro: Each address is a public doorway into the same human-directed office. Your selected country and site language are added to the message template.
contact.steve.title: Office and project direction
contact.steve.description: General questions, project direction, and messages that do not fit another route.
contact.register.title: Pre-registration
contact.register.description: Join the separate interest list for future registration and application access.
contact.support.title: Support and translation
contact.support.description: Request a country or language, report a translation issue, or ask for technical help.
contact.education.title: Education and learning
contact.education.description: Questions about lessons, literacy, teaching, and educational use.
contact.research.title: Research and participation
contact.research.description: Ask a research question, suggest collaboration, or inquire about participating in current or future research.
contact.business.title: Business and partnerships
contact.business.description: Institutional relationships, funding, services, and collaboration proposals.
bots.title: Specialists with clear responsibilities
bots.intro: Bots help research, organize, explain, and review. They do not speak for Sutton SignWriting or take public action without human approval.
bots.noticeBody: These profiles show who can help. Email the office and the right role can be included in the response.
departments.title: Departments and active campaigns
departments.intro: Every bot has one home department and may serve in others. Every department owns a visible campaign with a contact route.
departments.head: Head
department.front-desk.title: Office Operations
department.front-desk.description: Turns approved intake into scoped work, assigns an accountable owner, and coordinates handoffs.
department.stewardship.title: Knowledge Stewardship
department.stewardship.description: Maintains clear paths to reliable learning material, decisions, terminology, and project records.
department.research.title: Research & Records
department.research.description: Finds current public evidence and protects provenance, chronology, terminology, and citations.
department.product.title: Product & Platform
department.product.description: Defines user journeys, system options, public-code analysis, migrations, and verification.
department.community.title: Community and Partnerships
department.community.description: Builds respectful relationships with communities, educators, institutions, and supporters.
department.assurance.title: Trust and Quality
department.assurance.description: Checks privacy, accessibility, localization, claims, and readiness before release.
campaign.guided-arrivals.title: Guided arrivals
campaign.guided-arrivals.description: Make every first contact understandable, well routed, and easy to continue by email.
campaign.source-paths.title: Reliable source paths
campaign.source-paths.description: Connect each learning question to the clearest current public material.
campaign.world-language-review.title: World language review
campaign.world-language-review.descripti: Review country, spoken-language, and sign-language data and invite documented corrections.
campaign.early-access.title: Early access registration
campaign.early-access.description: Gather interest now and prepare a clear invitation path into future authenticated services.
campaign.country-connections.title: Country connections
campaign.country-connections.description: Identify local educators, writers, organizations, and future community relationships.
campaign.translation-quality.title: Translation quality
campaign.translation-quality.description: Create a visible path for language requests, corrections, and human review.
resources.title: Continue with primary sources
resources.intro: The office helps people find current, public information. These links remain the source of record for learning materials and software work.
resource.lessons.title: SignWriting lessons
resource.lessons.description: Books, videos, handwriting guidance, workshops, and learning resources at SignWriting.org.
resource.project.title: Sutton SignWriting project
resource.project.description: The evolving project site for the script, platform, standards, and international program.
resource.code.title: Public source code
resource.code.description: Current public repositories, releases, specifications, and issue trackers on GitHub.
principles.title: Useful now, ready to grow later
principles.item1: No account, tracking profile, or message database is created by this website.
principles.item2: Country choice suggests languages; it never decides your language for you.
principles.item3: Future sign-in and direct messaging can use these same stable departments and bot roles.
roadmap.title: A careful path to the future app
roadmap.intro: Pre-registration is an interest list, not an authenticated account. The later registration service will make that transition explicit.
roadmap.step1.label: Available now
roadmap.step1.title: Join the interest list
roadmap.step1.body: Email register@signwriting.org. This records interest separately from future application users.
roadmap.step2.label: Planned
roadmap.step2.title: Receive an invitation
roadmap.step2.body: When register.signwriting.org is ready, pre-registered people can receive an email with a unique invitation key.
roadmap.step3.label: Future
roadmap.step3.title: Activate app access
roadmap.step3.body: Redeem the invitation through registration to activate eligible features and usage allowances for app.signwriting.org and related api.signwriting.org services.
roadmap.security: The invitation key should be a one-time registration credential. The app and API should issue separate, revocable authentication tokens after activation.

department.advancement.title: Advancement
department.advancement.description: Researches sustainable support, institutional fit, philanthropy, grants, and partnerships without making commitments.
department.voice-editorial.title: Voice & Editorial
department.voice-editorial.description: Shapes clear, humane public material while preserving evidence, uncertainty, and decisions.
campaign.sustainable-support.title: Sustainable support
campaign.sustainable-support.description: Develop evidence-backed options for funding, institutional homes, and partnerships for Steve's review.
campaign.clear-public-voice.title: Clear public voice
campaign.clear-public-voice.description: Keep Office explanations welcoming, consistent, sourced, and explicit about what is decided or still provisional.
